audit.why: 48.43% over 382 games at 7/10 with Maokai holding rows 0-3 and row 6 is consistent across packet, full and content, and the mirror maokai__locke proposed no chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 why was the generic long-brawl line and did not say what changes against a champion whose heal refreshes itself.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is a dash and Purgatory grounds it, which is a real level-6 gain — but Sap Magic keeps restoring him above the execute threshold, which is why the row is Skill rather than Locke.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to state both halves.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent and one slot was garbled. Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced 'each time Maokai casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY'S SPELL' — so your own poke accelerates his healing, which inverts the page's advice to whittle him. Twisted Advance also makes him untargetable during the dash, so burst timed into it is thrown away. And spikes[0] writes 'Sapling Toss (W... E)'.
audit.why: A reader following 'chip him down' is actively feeding the sustain he is trying to beat. And an execute aimed at an untargetable dash simply does not land.
audit.corrected: Sap Magic's refund written into spikes[0].text, dosFull[0].d and wants.you[0]; the untargetable dash and the grounding into report[5].t and phases[4].why; Sapling Toss corrected to (E).

audit.why: report[8].t already says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain', which is the right call against a passive built on healing.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds, so his Twisted Advance engage can be denied — but Sap Magic keeps topping him back above the threshold. Even, not a kill.

edits.before: Maokai out-sustains you hard — his passive heals off spells and Sapling Toss (W... E) pokes you for free while regenerating; his Q (Bramble Smash) knockback zones your marks, so trading is a losing battle early.
edits.after: Maokai out-sustains you hard — Sap Magic heals off his attacks and its cooldown drops each time your spell hits him, so poking speeds his regen. Sapling Toss (E) pokes free and Bramble Smash (Q) knocks you out of mark range.

edits.before: Track Maokai’s Twisted Advance (Root): Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance makes him untargetable mid-dash — burst thrown into it is wasted. It is a dash, so Purgatory grounds the engage.

edits.before: Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Only commit once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Chip poke refunds Sap Magic — every spell you land on him shortens his heal's cooldown. Burst, don't chip.

edits.before: Dodge Sapling Toss (E) poke so his passive doesn't free-heal
edits.after: Burst instead of chipping — your spells refresh Sap Magic

edits.before: It levels off here — your first AP item plus Silver Stake missing-HP finally trade even against his sustain and tankiness, so you hold your own though neither solo-kills.
edits.after: It levels off here — your first AP item plus missing-health on-hit finally trade even against his sustain and tankiness, so you hold your own though neither solo-kills.

notes: The kit file's derived flags put 'grounding' on Maokai's Q (Bramble Smash), but Riot's description for it says only knockback, damage and slow. I did not write that Bramble Smash grounds your E anywhere — the description beats the flag. 'Silver Stake' was replaced with the verified description of Locke's passive in the one line where it fitted the band; the name is used across several Locke pages and needs one ruling from the user.
